main_text.l: Castúsque Musarum sacerdosVirginibus puerisque cantat:Pulchris tenellas qui studiis valetFormare mentes, qui simul arduaVirtutis occultum recludensMonstrat iter venerandus author.

Qui damna mollis pellit inertia,Prauúmque frenat ritè Cupidinem:Duros iuuentus vt laboresPro patria tolerare discat:Qui sancta fidos foedera coniugesSeruare cogit, commoda seu thoriLaudat fidelis seu pudorisIura sacri violata damnat:Qui facta non fert inclita fortiumObliuiones carpere limidas,Chartísve inornatos sileriEgregios pietate Reges.

Nam cum vaganti frena licentiaPonunt, pudendum cum scelus obruuntCulpásque conantur nocentesVindicibus remouere poenis,Fulgens nitenti vertice FaustitasIllustrat vrbes, rura Ceres beat,Et larga cornu plenioreCopia fundit opes benignas.
Hanc perge dulci materiem LyraeAptare, vastos ætheris vt petas

page.notes: Verse printed in italic throughout; initial capitals Q, M, P, N, H, A ornamented. Some words doubtful in the scan: "limidas" possibly "lividas"; "Prauúmque" as printed.
